payload.blocks: Seven running plans have no live lead on fg-server: 0016, 0143, 0144, 1220, 1224 (P0), 2324 (P1), 1247 (P2). Only 1003's lead lives. The planner for plan-claim started fine.
payload.headline: Every lead started on fg-server ends within 10-40 s (gate-lost); who finds out why?

parts.cause: Unknown. My cage cannot see a finished head's transcript (its home is finalized) or a pane after it closes, and lead:SUPERVISOR is on fg-server2 (remote), so I cannot hand the diagnosis to an unconfined session here. I stopped restarting: a blind retry gives the same result.

options.does: You or an unconfined session on fg-server runs `fgos session start lead --name forgent-261127-1247-compon-477ba` and watches its herdr pane to see what ends it
options.gain: Finds the cause in one try, then I restart all seven leads
options.harm: Needs about 10 minutes of a person or an unconfined session
options.label: Unconfined session diagnoses one start

options.does: I record the plans as parked with this reason and wait for fg-server2 or a later fix
options.label: Hold all seven plans

scope.allows: I restart the seven named leads once the cause is fixed
scope.forbids: Retrying lead starts in a loop before then

parts.what: At 07:45 all heads on fg-server (5 leads and the supervisor) were gate-lost at once. Since 08:28, every lead start (1220, 1247, 0016 twice, 1247 again at 08:35) ends with receipt gate-lost and empty stdout/stderr within 10 to 40 s. 1220's lead called `fgos done` 7 s in. Same account (claude-vantt) as the live 1003 lead and this supervisor. A planner started at 08:33 stays up.
